dedupe_keys.name: idem lists of permitted registered and approved waste facilities and operations indiana

description: This page publishes the lists of waste management facilities and operations that hold permits, registrations or approvals from the Office of Land Quality of the Indiana Department of Environmental Management. Lists are posted as PDF files by category. Hazardous waste lists cover pending applications, treatment, storage and disposal permits and post-closure and corrective action permits. Solid waste lists cover pending applications and permitted facilities, including construction and demolition landfills, municipal and non-municipal solid waste landfills, restricted waste sites, incinerators, material recovery facilities, medical and infectious waste treatment facilities and other processing operations, with further lists for other regulated operations; confined animal feeding operation permits are on a separate portal. Coverage is the state of Indiana and the lists are refreshed by the agency as permits change. The files are free to download online; the page states no licence. Caveats: PDF lists need extraction before analysis, they give facility names and locations, not capacities, and the date of each list must be read from the file. Simulation uses: an inventory of disposal and processing nodes for Indiana waste flow and service continuity models. Related records: the North Carolina layer (data-nc-deq-other-permitted-solid-waste-facilities) and the Texas facility files (data-tceq-msw-facility-data-files) cover other states in machine-readable form.
